title: powerfit: reproducibility materials for inverse fitting of power-diagram weights
description: Version 2.0.0: revised manuscript source, compiled article PDF, figure and build helpers, and frozen experimental protocols, inputs, and numerical results for inverse fitting of power-diagram weights from pairwise separator data. The all-versions project concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.19673557; it identifies the latest published project release. The experimental evidence used by the manuscript is preserved in the version-specific powerfit v1.0.0 archive, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19673558, and the calculations use pyvoro2 0.6.3, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19143984. This is a mixed-license reproducibility snapshot: first-party repository content is released under the MIT license, while bundled third-party runtime artifacts and official LaTeX support files retain their own upstream licenses and notices, documented in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. The Zenodo license field is therefore set to Other (Open) for the archive as a whole rather than relicensing third-party artifacts under MIT.
